source.author: Albert Hopman
source.title: Von Brest-Litovsk zur deutschen Novemberrevolution: Aus den Tagebuechern, Briefen und Aufzeichnungen von Alfons Paquet, Wilhelm Groener und Albert Hopman, Maerz bis November 1918
source.type: Published edition of contemporary primary diaries; the original manuscript was not inspected
source.publication_note: Link to institutional images. Full modern-edition page images and OCR are research intermediates and are not included as deliverables.

entries.verification: Both page images visually checked against institutional OCR.
entries.summary: Hopman records Asgard and Tresivolos arriving at Sevastopol at 09:00 on November 7, a decision to unload and return them to Poti, and Asgard leaving for Poti on November 9. This closely corroborates the p155 two-part shipping message.
entries.ciphertext_spelling: The unedited decrypted text has TRESIVOLUS twice; the diary edition prints Tresivolos. The spelling difference remains explicit.
entries.limits: No source coordinate, missing-slot position, p73 date, or p73 key follows uniquely from this contextual match.

entries.verification: Both page images visually checked against institutional OCR.
entries.summary: Hopman records Canterbury arriving at Sevastopol on November 24 and the Allied squadron arriving after 11:00 on November 26. This is independent German-side support for the existing naval interpretation, complementing the British ship logs.
entries.credit_note: The p217 body was published by Prinz and GPT-6 Astra on September 17, 2026; the 24 STEN coordinate correction was proposed by Christian Horvat on September 21. These diary links add corroboration, not new decipherment priority.
entries.limits: Historical agreement supports the reported AX=4 assignment but does not authenticate the reported key manuscript or prove a unique cipher reconstruction.

negative_scope.result: The inspected October 26-31 diary entries did not provide an exact p73 telegram parallel. This is a local negative result, not an exhaustive archival conclusion.
